title: 15 Years of Data, Still No Explanation #shorts
description:
NASA's ANITA balloon caught radio pulses that seemed to come up out of the Antarctic ice at steep angles, as if they had passed through thousands of kilometers of rock. In 2025, scientists checked 15 years of data from the Pierre Auger Observatory in Argentina. It should have seen many such events. It didn't. Verdict: still unknown.

Five more Antarctic mysteries are in the full video on the channel.

3D scenes are illustrations. Photo: ANITA-IV, Drummermean, CC BY-SA 4.0. Sources: Penn State (June 13, 2025); Pierre Auger Collaboration, Physical Review Letters (2025)
